will_defaults: I will direct money intentionally so it serves the target I chose.
I will review my numbers regularly and make decisions from reality, not mood.
will_not: I will not sabotage the goal with avoidable spending drift.
I will not ignore the numbers when they are inconvenient.
I will not treat future security like a low-priority expense.
reality_anchors: Financial progress is built by repeated measured decisions, not by occasional motivation.
